text:
Alex: quick Q — planning to roll the new session-affinity toggle to a 5% canary at 10:30 PT. Who is authorized to turn it off if we see an error spike?
Maya: oncall can do emergency disables for clear SLO breaches (latency >1s or error rate +3σ). org-wide shutdowns need EngSRE lead signoff. :warning:
Sriram: procedure we follow: open an incident (tag: toggle-disable), add ticket id, then run the CLI with reason & ticket. example: 
```
rictl feature set session-affinity=false --env prod --reason "canary error spike" --ticket RID-422
```
Maya: add to that — oncall must ping #incidents and @eng-sre when flipping. also annotate the rollback window.
ops-bot: Audit event created: toggle_change by maya@redwood (evt_9ab3) — session-affinity: true -> false — ticket RID-422
Jen: security reminder — if the toggle affects data handling paths, you must include the SSO approver group `prod-toggle-admins` in the incident and notify Security immediately.
Leo: to be explicit: who can flip? prod-toggle-admins group, EngSRE shift lead, and the emergency oncall. product PMs can request but not flip.
Alex: what if EngSRE doesn’t respond in 15m? escalate to platform lead?
Sriram: yes — escalate to @platform-team lead after 15m. note we enforce a 2-person rule for any org-wide disable: flipper + one approver (prod-toggle-admins or EngSRE lead).
Maya: post-flip checklist: 1) annotate incident with reason+ticket, 2) pin toggle state in rollout dashboard, 3) attach traces/link to Golden signals, 4) set temp-disable TTL tag (e.g., temp-disable:120m) so ops-bot can auto-reenable if needed.
Alex: ack — I'll prepare a small canary monitor playbook and put the checklist in the incident before we start.
ops-bot: Deployment monitor: canary_error_rate crossed threshold for session-affinity at 2032110050 — alert created — incident RID-422
Sriram: TL;DR: authorized flippers = prod-toggle-admins group + EngSRE shift lead + emergency oncall. Always open an incident, include ticket id in the rictl command, ops-bot writes the audit entry, and follow 2-person rule for org-wide disables. Escalate to platform lead after 15m if no response. Security gets looped if data paths are affected. :thumbsup:
